P_calibration.quote: Proving that evaluation was not the real purpose would be difficult for the government, though a court could read it narrowly.

P_grandfather_step.quote: A run that starts between enactment and the effective date is not grandfathered, but the prohibition is not yet in force.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Relying on an exemption requires that [X] actual activities fit both its text and its evident purpose. Counsel should assess whether any reading [X] would rely on is defensible, not only whether it is available.
